status: Home-Fire training completed; trained model available in webcam demo via --fire.

training.metrics_note: Aggregate validation metrics over all three classes; best metrics read from the final checkpoint, last metrics from the last checkpoint. These are not detection percentages or independent test scores.

example_predictions_at_confidence_025.note: Recorded predictions, not manually verified correctness metrics.

limitations: Person labels are COCO pseudo-labels; annotation completeness is not guaranteed.
Validation person metrics use pseudo-labels, not independently verified person ground truth.
Original dataset splits were retained; separation by source video has not been verified.
No full independent held-out benchmark or verified indoor-drone performance yet.
Completed checkpoints are stripped of optimizer state: inference and fresh fine-tuning are possible; exact training resume is not.

discarded_prototype.status: Discarded prototype; no usable detection quality
limitations: Only three epochs and small development subsets; scores are not detection percentages or independent test results.
Person baseline was weak before fine-tuning; evaluation setup and small objects at 320px were not fully investigated.
D-Fire person pseudo-labels were generated by AerialPerson and not reviewed (11 boxes on 256 training images).
VisDrone was not checked for missing smoke/fire labels.
The three-class D-Fire-only ablation deliberately removed person labels; incomplete labels confound conclusions about forgetting.
Software tests checked contracts, not annotation completeness or model quality.
discarded_prototype.next_approach: COCO yolo26n.pt + D-Fire only; COCO-generated person labels; classes person/smoke/fire. No VisDrone or AerialPerson.
